description: Every dependency manifest tracked in the repository is audited against OSV by pip-audit in a workflow: the three application manifests in the build, and the collector's own root manifest in the policy workflow (added 2026-10-07, when it was found audited nowhere)

matrix_rows.gap: Python manifests only. Terraform providers are pinned by lock-file hash but not correlated with advisories, and the build's matrix values are trusted rather than expanded: a service added to the repository but not the matrix would still fail here, since its manifest is undeclared.
